site.title: AI Kompas
site.tagline: Students learn to navigate a world with AI.

module1.title: Working Smart with AI, Without Cheating

blok1.title: What can AI do and not do?
blok1.intro: AI is a smart system that has learned a lot — but it doesn't actually think.

quiz.question: Who did this: a human or an AI?

blok2.title: How do you ask a good question?
blok2.intro: A good question to AI is called a prompt. The better your question, the better the answer.

quiz.question: Which prompt is better?
options: Write a short poem about the sea, in English, for children aged 10
quiz.feedback_wrong: Look carefully at both options again.

blok3.title: How do you know if AI is correct?
blok3.intro: AI makes mistakes. That's normal. You always need to check what AI says.

quiz.question: Is this AI answer correct or not?

blok4.title: When does AI help and when is it cheating?
blok4.intro: AI is a tool, not a replacement for your own thinking.

quiz.question: Is this allowed or not?
quiz.feedback_wrong: Think again about what the teacher wants you to learn.
